title: BONG acceptance evidence
source: Supplied BONG handoff acceptance tests; all requirement IDs and scenario text are retained in this application-local matrix.

statusPolicy.PASS: Every assertion in the row is supported within its required scope.
statusPolicy.PARTIAL: Some implementation or executed local evidence exists;remaining requirements/environments are explicitly open.
statusPolicy.NOT_RUN: No adequate executed evidence for this row. A named test/proposed procedure is not a passing result.
statusPolicy.note: PARTIAL is an explicit implementation tracking label. No partial/not-run row clears its required launch gate.
